title: SalesDashboard loads ALL contracts and MSAs with no $top cap and no active_flag filter
detail: Line 62: `apiGet('/dcfg_contracts?$select=dcfg_contractid,dcfg_status,...')` â€” no $filter for dcfg_active_flag eq true, no $top. Loads every contract ever created including soft-deleted. Line 63: same for MSAs (no filter at all). Line 64: same for customers (no filter, no $top). Dashboard is flagged as 'no caching - fresh fetch every mount' (line 4 comment JS-10), so every route change to / re-runs these. At current scale (~200 contracts) this is fine. At 2,000 contracts the dashboard becomes the single most expensive page load in the SPA.
recommendedFix: Add filters where appropriate: contracts `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true`, MSAs `$filter=statecode eq 0`, customers `$filter=dcfg_active_flag eq true`. Add `$top=500` as a safety cap. Consider computing KPI values via a server-side Power Automate rollup stored in dcfg_configs so the dashboard reads 5 numbers instead of thousands of rows.
